shared_elements: upright stone slab/monolith with rounded top
low-relief carving on a single flat face
horizontal banding dividing the surface into zones
suggestion of a frontal human head/face (A) and human figures in profile (B)
justification: Both are tall, dark, rounded-topped stone slabs carved in low relief on one face, with the surface organised into stacked horizontal zones and including at least one prominent circular/disc element and human anatomical reference. But A's carving is bold, weathered, sculptural and integral to a three-dimensional anthropomorphic body, whereas B is a flat, thinly incised plaque with crisp profile figures, an offering stand and dense rows of script — an entirely different mode of representation and no shared compositional scheme.
